inputs.body:
@if(
    empty(string(last(body('SharePoint_Request')))),
    '',
    if(
        empty(
            string(
                last(triggerBody())?['Output']
            )
        ),
        if(
            empty(string(last(body('SharePoint_Request'))?['d']?['results'])),
            removeProperty(
                removeProperty(
                    removeProperty(
                        removeProperty(
                            removeProperty(
                                removeProperty(
                                    removeProperty(
                                        removeProperty(
                                            removeProperty(
                                                removeProperty(
                                                    removeProperty(
                                                        removeProperty(
                                                            removeProperty(
                                                                removeProperty(
                                                                    removeProperty(
                                                                        removeProperty(
                                                                            removeProperty(
                                                                                removeProperty(
                                                                                    removeProperty(
                                                                                        removeProperty(
                                                                                            removeProperty(
                                                                                                last(body('SharePoint_Request'))?['d'],
                                                                                                'ComplianceAssetId'
                                                                                            ),
                                                                                            'OData__ColorTag'
                                                                                        ),
                                                                                        'ContentTypeId'
                                                                                    ),
                                                                                    'ServerRedirectedEmbedUrl'
                                                                                ),
                                                                                'ServerRedirectedEmbedUri'
                                                                            ),
                                                                            'FileSystemObjectType'
                                                                        ),
                                                                        'Versions'
                                                                    ),
                                                                    'Properties'
                                                                ),
                                                                'ParentList'
                                                            ),
                                                            'LikedByInformation'
                                                        ),
                                                        'Folder'
                                                    ),
                                                    'File'
                                                ),
                                                'FieldValuesForEdit'
                                            ),
                                            'FieldValuesAsText'
                                        ),
                                        'FieldValuesAsHtml'
                                    ),
                                    'GetDlpPolicyTip'
                                ),
                                'ContentType'
                            ),
                            'AttachmentFiles'
                        ),
                        'RoleAssignments'
                    ),
                    'FirstUniqueAncestorSecurableObject'
                ),
                '__metadata'
            ),
            last(body('SharePoint_Request'))?['d']
        ),
        if(
            empty(string(last(body('SharePoint_Request'))?['d']?['results'])),
            last(body('SharePoint_Request'))?['d']?[
                last(triggerBody())?['Output']
            ],
            first(last(body('SharePoint_Request'))?['d']?['results'])?[
                last(triggerBody())?['Output']
            ]
        )
    )
)

Set_Request_Output.description: I didn't use loop here because nested removeProperty() performs faster
